programs.description: Mitch Buchannon, the respected and beloved lifeguard of Florida's Baywatch, assembles a new team to take down a drug baron and safeguard the beach.
Michael Woods, a traveller and a parolee, picks up the wrong rental car to meet his wife which makes him the prime target of a group of corrupt police officers.
Rebecca Scott, a widowed reporter, teams up with an FBI agent to uncover the mystery of her husband's death. However, things take a turn when they are targeted by unknown enemies.
Frank Martin, a former mercenary, is hired by a woman and her accomplices to fulfil a contract. Soon, however, he must join forces with them to bring down a Russian crime lord.
Detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of a demonic serial killer, Edgar Reese. However, questions arise when the murders start again, eerily matching the modus operandi of Reese.
Courtney Collins, a single mother, relocates to a rural home with her twin sons. Later, she discovers it's inhabited by malevolent spirits connected to the sinister entity Bughuul.
After years of being at odds with each other, the birds and the pigs are forced to work together when a common enemy attempts to drive them away from their homes.
With the kingdom in need of a ruler after King Harold's death, Shrek embarks on a quest to find Arthur, Fiona's cousin, while Prince Charming plans to seize control of the throne.
After being granted the divine power of the Egyptian Gods and spending almost 5000 years in a guardhouse, Black Adam is freed and decides to unleash his style of justice on the world.
A legendary monster named King Ghidorah awakens Rodan, as well as other titans, to destroy the world. To defeat them, the crypto-zoological organisation Monarch must rely on the almighty Godzilla.
Three minions embark on an adventure to find a new master. Chaos erupt when they decide to serve Scarlett Overkill, a super-villain who ploys to rule the world.
An underworld prince ignites a war against humanity to conquer Earth. Consequently, Hellboy and his squad must prevent him from unlocking a lethal army.
Bestowed with superpowers, Shazam and his foster siblings join forces against the daughters of Atlas who have stolen the Wizard's broken staff.
An ancient princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia and terrors that defy human comprehension.

Maximus is a Roman general, loved by the people and the aging Emperor. The Emperor chooses Maximus to be his heir over his own son and a power struggle leaves Maximus and his family condemned to death.
